ICC22 EE.48 2208 SOV 
Western-Southern Life Assurance Company 
Statement of Variability 
Date: August 17, 2022 
This Statement of Variability applies to the following form: 
ICC22 EE.48 2208, Account Value Band Interest Rate Endorsement 
We certify that we will administer any change to a variable item in accordance with the requirements 
in this Statement of Variability, including any requirements for prior approval of a change.  
The variable information is identified by brackets and may change as indicated below. 
Description 
Variable Explanation 
1 
Officer Signatures and 
Titles 
We reserve the right to change if the relevant individuals or titles should change in 
the future.
